sentences.text:
This is the first application seeking for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant/accused-Arshad @ Asad Baks, who has been convicted under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code r/w 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for life and to pay fine of Rs.1,000/- and further convicted under Sections 66-E and 67 of the Information and Technology Act, 2000 and sentenced to R.I. for 1 year and 1 year and to pay fine of Rs.1,000/- and Rs.1,000/-
with default stipulations as mentioned in the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 22.02.2023 passed by the Special Judge, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, District Sidhi in Special Sessions Case No.90 of 2021.

entities.text: Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, District Sidhi
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. The application for suspension of sentence and bail has been filed on the ground that the appellant as well as the prosecutrix were known to each other.
He has invited attention of this court to the statement of prosecutrix wherein she has admitted the fact regarding making physical relationship with the appellant on false pretext of marriage.
The same cannot be considered to be an offence of rape committed by the appellant.
There is no evidence of pressurizing the prosecutrix to develop physical relations.
There is no likelihood of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
The appellant is in jail since 03.08.2021.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
4. P e r contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the contentions stating therein that it is not on one occassion that he has made physical relations with the prosecutrix.
He has taken photographs of the prosecutrix threatening her to make those photographs viral and continued to commit the offence and subsequently made the photographs viral.
In view of the aforesaid, he has prayed for rejection of the application.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances and the fact that the appellant has continuously committed the offence by giving threat to the prosecutrix to make her photograph viral, this Court does not deem it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
6. Accordingly, I.A. No.30123 of 2023 is rejected.
